title: Narwhal Ka Sach! 🐋 #shorts
idea: The narwhal's horn is actually an overgrown 3-meter canine tooth filled with millions of nerve endings.

lines.text: Kya samundar mein asli Unicorn ghoomta hai?
Is Narwhal ka seeng asal mein ek 3 meter lamba daant hai!
Ye khokhla daant iske oopri jabde se baahar nikalta hai.
Is ajeeb daant mein laakho nerve endings hoti hain!
Isse ye paani ka taapmaan aur pressure turant samajh leta hai!
Kya aapne pehle kabhi aisa daant dekha tha?

youtube.title: Narwhal Ka 3 Meter Lamba Daant! 🐋 #shorts
youtube.description:
Kya aapko pata tha ki Narwhal ka seeng asal mein ek super sensitive daant hai? Dekhiye is anokhe jaanwar ka dhasu sach!

facts.claim: The narwhal's tusk is 1.5 to 3.0 m long.
The tusk has millions of nerve endings to sense temperature and water pressure.
